summary: Ergonomic chair delivery + temporary badge provisioning for short-term contractor at SF-4
description:
Issue summary: Short-term contractor (vendor: BrightTemp Solutions) starts on 2026-03-15 and needs an ergonomic task chair delivered to desk A4-12 and a temporary building badge that expires automatically after 30 days. Impact: Contractor cannot access the floor or work comfortably until chair and badge are provisioned, blocking installation verification work scheduled for week of 2026-03-16. Requested by: Eng manager (N. Patel).

Required deliverables:
- Chair delivered to desk A4-12 by 2026-03-14 EOD.
- Temporary badge provisioned with floor and elevator access, valid 2026-03-15 through 2026-04-14.
- Chair asset tagged and recorded in inventory; return instructions added to contractor exit checklist.

Notes: Vendor will ship via FedEx Ground; tracking provided. Shipping should go to Mailroom \"Attention: Facilities - Aisha Khatri\" and then to Facilities for same-day delivery to desk. Security change must be scheduled with badge admin (see comments).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Confirm contractor start date and desk assignment with hiring manager.
2) Place order for ergonomic chair (model: Humanscale Freedom or approved equivalent) through procurement.
3) Provide vendor shipping address and receiving instructions to procurement.
4) Once tracking is available, Facilities to coordinate pickup from Mailroom and deliver to desk A4-12.
5) Security to create temporary badge and test elevator/floor access before contractor arrival.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Facilities confirmed A4-12 is an active hot-desk assigned as a dedicated spot for contractor during engagement.
2026-03-10: Procurement placed chair order; ETA from vendor 2026-03-13–2026-03-14. PO #PO-33211.
2026-03-11: FedEx shipment created (tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784) — currently in transit, expected delivery 2026-03-14 morning to Mailroom.
2026-03-11: Security requires contractor full name, government ID scan, and manager approval link to provision badge. Manager approved via email at 2026-03-11 09:42 PST.
Hypothesis: If chair arrives on time and security provisioning completes, contractor will be ready by first day. If either step fails, work will be delayed by 24–48 hours.

resolution: In progress — procurement order placed and shipment inbound. Facilities delivery and Security provisioning scheduled for 2026-03-14. If any step fails, escalate to Ops lead.
